LCOM-ALUM.description: Aluminum Design Load Combination (LCOM-ALUM). Each keyed entry is one load combination for aluminum design; NAME and the vCOMB list of (analysis-type, load-case, factor) terms drive the combination, while iTYPE selects how the terms are summed.

NO.description: Read-only combination number assigned by the program on GET; ignored on write.

NAME.description: Combination name. Must be unique when adding a new combination.

ACTIVE.description: Active/usage type of the combination. Typical values: "ACTIVE", "INACTIVE", "STRENGTH", "SERVICE". Converted internally to an integer code; case handling follows the program's active-type mapping.

bES.description: Elastic-stage flag. Applied only for the concrete design load-combination type (LCOM-CONC); the handler ignores this field for the ALUMINUM type, so it has no effect here.

bCB.description: Read-only min/max/envelope combination flag reported on GET (true when the combination is a min/max/all result type); ignored on write.

iTYPE.description: Summation method for the combination terms. Add: 0, Envelope: 1, ABS: 2, SRSS: 3.

iSERV_TYPE.description: EC serviceability combination sub-type code. Not applied by the current handler (reserved/unused).

nLCOMTYPE.description: EC load-combination sub-type code. Not applied by the current handler (reserved/unused).

nSEISTYPE.description: EC seismic combination sub-type code. Not applied by the current handler (reserved/unused).

vCOMB.description: List of combination terms. Each term references a load case (by analysis type and case name) and a scale factor; the handler clears and rebuilds the combination from this list on every write.

ANAL.description: Analysis type of the referenced load case (case-insensitive). ST=Static, RS=Response Spectrum, TH=Time History, MV=Moving, SM=Settlement/Support Movement, ENVL=Envelope, CB=General Combination, CBS/CBC/CBF/CBR=combination variants, PO=Pushover, CS=Construction Stage, ES=Elastic Stage/Erection, GI=Geometric Initial, CN=Construction, CBA/CBSC/CBCF/CBSM/CBLN=further combination variants, NRS=Nonlinear RS, NES=Nonlinear ES.

LCNAME.description: Name of the referenced load case. Must resolve to an existing load case of the given analysis type or the write is rejected.

FACTOR.description: Scale factor applied to the referenced load case.
